requirement.applicantContext: September 2027 IB Diploma entry for Veterinary Science (BVSc) (UCAS D105).
requirement.subjectNotes: Obtain HL 6 in biology, chemistry and a third subject of your choice.
requirement.conditions: Complete the IB Diploma. The school bases its standard offer on individual subject grades. Additional mathematics, English and physics conditions apply if you did not take GCSEs or equivalent qualifications.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Joint BVSc academic and language requirements
source.evidence: 666 at Higher Level including: Biology Chemistry A third subject of your choice
